CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Spirit? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Holy Spirit has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Holy Spirit.
   C. Use The Holy Spirit to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Holy Spirit with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Origin and Consequences of Sin? (1 mark)
   A. Say Origin and Consequences of Sin has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Origin and Consequences of Sin.
   C. Apply the teaching of Origin and Consequences of Sin with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Origin and Consequences of Sin to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Faith and God’s Promises? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Faith and God’s Promises.
   B. Use Faith and God’s Promises to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Faith and God’s Promises has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Faith and God’s Promises with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Spirit 7 5.2 Acts of Compassion 7 Page 13 of 72 xiii 6.0 Christian Livi? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Holy Spirit 7 5.2 Acts of Compassion 7 Page 13 of 72 xiii 6.0 Christian Livi with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Holy Spirit 7 5.2 Acts of Compassion 7 Page 13 of 72 xiii 6.0 Christian Livi.
   C. Use The Holy Spirit 7 5.2 Acts of Compassion 7 Page 13 of 72 xiii 6.0 Christian Livi to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The Holy Spirit 7 5.2 Acts of Compassion 7 Page 13 of 72 xiii 6.0 Christian Livi has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5.
   B. Apply the teaching of Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5 with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5 to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5 has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Leadership in Israel: Saul? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Leadership in Israel: Saul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Leadership in Israel: Saul has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Leadership in Israel: Saul.
   D. Use Leadership in Israel: Saul to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

8. Which response best shows understanding of Calming the Storm? (1 mark)
   A. Say Calming the Storm has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Calming the Storm.
   C. Apply the teaching of Calming the Storm with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Calming the Storm to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of God’s Plan for Redemption? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of God’s Plan for Redemption with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say God’s Plan for Redemption has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing God’s Plan for Redemption.
   D. Use God’s Plan for Redemption to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Teachings on Prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Say Teachings on Prayer has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Teachings on Prayer to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Teachings on Prayer with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Teachings on Prayer.

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Cheating in exams

12. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Leisure and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Origin and Consequences of Sin and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain God’s Plan for Redemption and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Faith and God’s Promises and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
